title: WebSocket client capability negotiation
description: Before shipping multiple client types, the handshake needs a version field and client-type declaration. Server currently assumes all clients speak the full protocol. Need: protocol version, client type (browser/mobile/desktop/bot), supported features. This is a prerequisite for safely evolving the protocol across heterogeneous clients.
close_reason: Hello/welcome handshake with protocol_version, client_type, capabilities. Server validates version, 5s handshake timeout. Shared types in engine, client sends hello on connect.
